- Stops personal cars and motorcycles from choosing street parking. - For visually cleaner streets, or just a little more control over car parking. - They can still park in: parking lots/buildings, or parking included with some buildings.
## Options - No Street Parking [x] - enabled by default for the whole city. -Future options may include per district street parking control.
### Good to know - Cars already parked on streets leave naturally when used again. Clearing can take several in-game months, and cars whose owners rarely drive may remain longer. A vanilla road upgrade that rebuilds or removes curb parking can clear that curb immediately. - A few cars may remain after roads are built or upgraded while the game finishes updating parking lanes and paths. This is temporary and they leave naturally. - Parking Control’s temporary restriction is not written permanently into the city. - Vanilla road upgrades remain saved normally. - Safe to remove: removing the mod lets regular streets return to vanilla parking behavior. - If you run out of parking spaces, then normal vanilla behavior handles the overflow, including hidden storage at outside connections. - Note that not providing enough parking spaces can cause excess driving aroundm this is vanilla behavior (recommend also getting Realistic Parking mod). - The mod does not delete cars. In testing, most existing cars cleared over several in-game months, but cars whose owners rarely drive may remain longer. Upgrading a road with vanilla road tools can clear that curb immediately.
